# Welcome! {.unnumbered}

Hello!
Welcome to the *Quantitative Data Analysis for Linguists in R* textbook!
This is the textbook for the [Quantitative Methods in Linguistics and English Language](https://uoelel.github.io/qml/) course at the University of Edinburgh, but the textbook is open to all.

Cite as:

> Stefano Coretta.
> 2025.
> Quantitative data analysis for linguists in R \[v1.0\].
> <https://stefanocoretta.github.io/qdal/>.
